about.headline: Engineering with the mindset of a builder, analyst, and team lead.
about.body: I am a Mechanical Engineering undergraduate at NSUT focused on designing high-performance systems that are practical to manufacture, validate, and scale. My work spans chassis design, structural analysis, autonomous simulation, process improvement, and team leadership across national competitions and industrial internships.
focusAreas: CAD and CAE for vehicles, mechanisms, and component systems
Manufacturing optimization using MOST, KAIZEN, and Lean Six Sigma
Technical leadership across ASME, IEEE, motorsports, and robotics teams
